interface.name: monstar_host_v1

description.summary: terminal window management by a hosting application

interface.description:
A hosting application, such as monstar-qt, embeds terminal surfaces as tabs and splits. It advertises this global so a terminal can forward window-management key bindings that it cannot perform on its own.
Compositors that are not terminal hosts do not advertise this global.

request.name: perform_action

description.summary: ask the host to perform a window action

request.description:
Ask the host to perform a window-management action on behalf of the toplevel whose wl_surface is given. The action uses Ghostty's key binding action syntax, for example "new_tab", "new_split:right", "goto_split:left", "goto_tab:2", or "resize_split:up,10". Hosts ignore actions they do not support.
working_directory is the terminal's current directory, when known, so new tabs, splits, and windows can start in it.
